meaning.t_white_mean: mean T over F1..F8 under the white LED, unit(T, 0, 1)
meaning.t_white_tilt: mean T F6..F8 minus mean T F1..F3 under white, clamp(-1, 1)  (red-vs-blue lean)
meaning.t_clear: T of the CLEAR channel under white, unit(T, 0, 1)
meaning.uv_response: mean T over F4..F8 under the 365 nm LED, unit(T, 0, 2)  (visible light seen under UV relative to PTFE; DERIVED, not a fluorescence claim)
meaning.t_nir: T of the NIR channel under the 940 nm LED, unit(T, 0, 1)
meaning.valid_frac: fraction of the 40 mode x channel T values that were valid, unit(x, 0, 1)

meaning.tilt: IMU accel Z in g, unit(az, -1, 1)
meaning.battery: battery voltage, unit(mV, 3300, 4200)  (ESTIMATE until the divider is checked with a meter)

privacy: Crystal and body features are numeric summaries extracted on the Spark/host. They stay in the Spark host (overlay sources are NOT written to the Beast Box FeatureStore, so Cory's LiveRouter is unaffected).
